Apple and LG team up on new smart home gear, starting with a lock, doorbell, and thermostat

T
By The Verge Editorial Desk Verified Wire Reporting • News Seconds Network
⚡ Visual Story
Source & Photography: The Verge Wire Dispatch Verified Editorial Asset
⚡ Executive Takeaways & Key Highlights
  • Apple is collaborating with LG on a new lineup of smart home devices, including a video doorbell, thermostat, indoor camera, and more, according to a report from Bloomberg .
  • The products will reportedly feature LG branding but integrate with the company's rumored smart home hub that's expected to launch during an event on October 13th.
  • Official reporting verified via The Verge news desk.

Apple is collaborating with LG on a new lineup of smart home devices, including a video doorbell, thermostat, indoor camera, and more, according to a report from Bloomberg . The products will reportedly feature LG branding but integrate with the company's rumored smart home hub that's expected to launch during an event on October 13th.
